method: Three ordinary exterior pictures actually inspected; standard viewer PMTiles for fit and Terrarium for approximate grade. No bespoke research or downloaded meshes.

references.observed: Upper-palace aerial actually inspected: four green domed corner pavilions, three raised central green mansard/hipped blocks, long lower wings and terraced garden-facing frontage, projecting pool-side entry. This picture shows the Upper palace, not the whole two-palace campus. Independent annexes and city blocks remain map context.

Pool-side Upper frontage actually inspected: three tall arched central closed entries below a curved white crown, tall rectangular glazing, white/cream pilasters and cornices, three distinct green central roof crowns, green domed corner pavilions, dormers/chimneys and original simplified urn rhythm. No copied sculpture, heraldry or text.

Lower garden front actually inspected: long white single principal story, red hipped/mansard roofs with small dormers/chimneys, raised central three-window hall, white pierced balustrades and simplified original urns, green closed central/side doors and tall rectangular glazing. PMTiles supplies its bent rear courtyard ranges, which are included; independent western annexes remain native.
